articles.title: The proof is in the pudding, or is it?
articles.description: The new discipline of theoretical cooking enables chefs to innovate recipes without physical preparation. Culinary creativity is liberated from the constraints of cooking processes and ingredient limitations. Recipes will be judged based on their conceptual design rather than taste or presentation. Critics may argue that this approach removes the essence of cooking and eating experiences. However, the theoretical aspect offers a novel perspective on gastronomy and culinary arts.

The commission also faces staffing shortages and budgetary constraints affecting its performance.

articles.title: RJ Mitte dies at 34: What to know about Cerebral Palsy, the condition he shared with his ‘Breaking Bad’ character
articles.description: RJ Mitte, the actor renowned for playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, has passed away at age 34. He was diagnosed with cerebral palsy and worked tirelessly to challenge stereotypes surrounding disabilities. Mitte served as an ambassador for organizations promoting disability awareness and inclusion, utilizing his platform to advocate for better representation. His sudden death is under investigation, with no signs of foul play at this time.
